text:
Here are five practice questions on information security program metrics. Try them without notes, then say "answers" when you're ready.

**1.** Your board asks for a single metric that shows whether the security team is finding incidents before customers do. Which metric best answers this?
- A) Mean time to contain (MTTC)
- B) Percentage of incidents detected internally versus reported externally
- C) Total number of incidents per quarter
- D) Annual security budget as a percentage of revenue

**2.** Patch compliance is reported at 94% across the estate. The CISO asks what this number hides. Which follow-up metric gives the most useful additional context?
- A) Number of patches released by vendors this quarter
- B) Percentage of critical and high vulnerabilities unpatched beyond the defined SLA, broken down by environment
- C) Total number of servers in the estate
- D) Number of change requests submitted this quarter

**3.** A security manager reports that phishing simulation click rates dropped from 18% to 6% over 12 months. The CFO asks whether spending on awareness training is justified. Which additional metric strengthens the business case?
- A) Number of training modules published
- B) Reduction in confirmed phishing incidents and credential compromises over the same period
- C) Number of employees who completed the training
- D) Total cost of the phishing simulation platform

**4.** Which metric is a leading indicator of security posture rather than a lagging indicator?
- A) Number of data breaches in the last 12 months
- B) Percentage of critical assets with current risk assessments and owners
- C) Total cost of incidents last year
- D) Number of regulatory fines received

**5.** A CISO presents mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR) to the audit committee. The committee asks what good looks like. Which statement is most defensible?
- A) MTTD and MTTR should always be under one hour for every incident
- B) Targets should be set by severity tier, benchmarked against industry peers, and improved quarter over quarter
- C) The metrics do not matter as long as no breaches occur
- D) Only MTTD matters because detection is the hardest part
